name: Martech Medical Products Inc
old_description: To be the leading solution provider for every customer we serve. To drive sustainable growth of our business through the continued investment in our people, technology and quality while delivering world class products and services.
about:
Martech Medical Products operates from Harleysville, Pennsylvania, with a second facility in Mexicali, Mexico. The company was founded in 1978 and initially built its reputation as a supplier of high-quality extrusions and molded components for the medical device industry.

Today Martech provides concept-to-production services across three manufacturing and engineering sites totaling 200,000 square feet and employing over 2,000 people. Its internal capabilities span R&D, project management, 3D printing, tool design, extrusion, molding, tipping, printing, coating, drilling, machining, assembly, packaging, and sterilization, enabling finished catheter and silicone product manufacturing under one roof.

The company serves top medical device manufacturers worldwide, with a historical focus on catheter-based solutions such as epidural and hemodialysis catheters. Its customer base includes firms requiring both small-scale development and large-volume production.

Martech emphasizes its ability to handle projects of any size, offering services that smaller companies lack and larger companies prefer not to allocate internally. By integrating every phase — from design conception through FDA validations to shipping — it positions itself as a single-source partner that reduces production costs and accelerates timelines.
